answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A signal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the fable of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
